instructions.instruction: Use `npx zenn new:article` to create a new article; add `--slug <name>` to specify the slug explicitly
instructions.original_snippets: npx zenn new:article...To specify the slug: npx zenn new:article --slug my-article-slug
instructions.relevant_when: When creating a new Zenn article from scratch

instructions.instruction: Slug must be 12–50 characters using only lowercase alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores
instructions.original_snippets: Slug rules: 12–50 characters, lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and underscores only.
instructions.relevant_when: When creating a new article or validating an existing slug

instructions.instruction: Use `type: "tech"` for technical procedures, tutorials, or how-to articles; use `type: "idea"` for opinion, reflection, or experience-based articles
instructions.original_snippets: type: "tech" # tech（技術記事）or idea（アイデア・意見）
instructions.relevant_when: When configuring front matter for a new article

instructions.instruction: Specify 1–5 topics in front matter; use Zenn's existing topic names in lowercase to improve discoverability
instructions.original_snippets: topics: ["topic1", "topic2"] # 1–5 topics...topics の選び方: Zenn上の既存トピック名と一致させると検索に載りやすい
instructions.relevant_when: When configuring topics for a new or updated article

instructions.instruction: Set `published: false` while the article is a draft; only change it to `true` when the article is ready to go live
instructions.original_snippets: published: false # false until ready to publish
instructions.relevant_when: Any time front matter is being configured or an article is being prepared for publication

instructions.instruction: Run `npx zenn preview` to preview the article locally at http://localhost:8000; the preview hot-reloads on file save
instructions.original_snippets: npx zenn preview...Opens at http://localhost:8000. The preview hot-reloads on file save.
instructions.relevant_when: While writing or editing article content, to catch rendering issues early

instructions.instruction: Set `published: true` in front matter when the article is ready to be published
instructions.relevant_when: When preparing a finished draft for publication

instructions.instruction: Use a branch + pull request workflow to publish: `git checkout -b article/<slug>`, commit, push with `-u origin article/<slug>`, then open a pull request to merge into main
instructions.original_snippets:
git checkout -b article/<slug>
git add articles/<slug>.md
git commit -m "Add article: <title>"
git push -u origin article/<slug>...Open a pull request and merge into `main`.
instructions.relevant_when: When publishing a finished article via GitHub

instructions.instruction: Add `published_at: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM"` (JST, future datetime) to schedule publication rather than publishing immediately
instructions.original_snippets: 公開予約する場合: `published_at` を追加（JST、未来の日時）: published_at: "2025-04-01 09:00"
instructions.relevant_when: When the article should go live at a specific future time rather than immediately
